paraphrase: Entreated by Brahmā, Rudra and others, the Lord descended as Vyāsa; seeing people suffering in saṃsāra for want of knowledge of the Veda, and women, śūdras and others who are not entitled to the Veda, he compassionately composed the Mahābhārata — expanding the Vedic meaning and centred on the Lord alone — so that they too might reach liberation through dharma and knowledge.
speaker: Madhva
